blocks.text: Ice Seguerra is bringing the 25th anniversary celebration of his hit song “Pagdating ng Panahon” to London, United Kingdom, where he is set to perform for Filipino fans on Friday, Nov. 20. Seguerra took to Facebook on Monday, Nov.16, to share photos of his departure with his partner, Liza Diño, as they headed to the UK for the concert. “Off to the UK for the Pagdating ng Panahon 25th Anniversary World Tour! It’s my first time doing a solo concert in London, and I’m so excited to sing for our kababayans there,” he wrote. The concert will be held at The […]...
